desert.label: Desert
desert.description: Bare desert with little persistent vegetation.

sparse.label: Sparse
sparse.description: Thin, discontinuous vegetation over exposed ground.

grasslands.label: Grasslands
grasslands.description: Open land dominated by grasses and herbs.

farmland.label: Farmland
farmland.description: A landscape with extensive cultivated fields.

woods.label: Woods
woods.description: An open wooded landscape with substantial clearings.

jungle.label: Jungle
jungle.description: Humid tropical forest with dense evergreen growth.

scrubland.label: Scrubland
scrubland.description: Scattered woody shrubs with open ground between them.

thicket.label: Thicket
thicket.description: Dense shrubs and tangled woody growth.

savanna.label: Savanna
savanna.description: Grassland with scattered trees and open woodland.

tundra.label: Tundra
tundra.description: Low mosses, lichens, herbs and dwarf shrubs.

mixed_forest.label: Mixed Forest
mixed_forest.description: Forest with a mixture of evergreen and deciduous trees.

dry_forest.label: Dry Forest
dry_forest.description: Seasonal forest whose trees shed much of their foliage in the dry season.

marsh.label: Marsh
marsh.description: Wet ground dominated by reeds, sedges and other low vegetation.

swamp.label: Swamp
swamp.description: Wet ground with substantial tree cover.

saltmarsh.label: Saltmarsh
saltmarsh.description: Coastal saline wetland with low salt-tolerant vegetation.

mangroves.label: Mangroves
mangroves.description: Coastal woodland with trees adapted to tidal water and saline conditions.

assumptions: Historical canopy closure is inferred from LUH2 wooded landscape fraction; not measured within-stand tree density.
HYDE3.4 year1300 cropland is primary; LUH2 v2h year1300 supplies fallbacks, grazing and forest fraction. They share historical data and are not independent.

GLWD 1990-2020 supplies wetland vegetation types. Wetland loss between 1700 and 2020, computed within the same reconstruction, restores plausible wet ground with its half-degree budget conserved. Location and type of lost wetland are inferred; this is not dated 1300 evidence.
Type thresholds are shared classification rules, not population or capacity fitting.
New types inherit existing vanilla vegetation effects for this visual/mechanical prototype. No new balance coefficients are calibrated.
